items.title: Korea Treasury Bonds Decline as External Yields and Equities Rebound
items.title_ko: 대외 금리 상승과 증시 반등 속에 국고채 금리 약세
items.summary: Korea Treasury bond yields rose on November 9 as domestic equities rebounded and external yields increased. At 11:04 AM, the three-year KTB benchmark yield rose 3.7 bp from the previous day's eval to 3.655%. The 10-year and 30-year KTB benchmark yields increased by 3.4 bp to 3.889% and 1.9 bp to 3.991%, respectively. Three-year KTB futures dropped 13 ticks to 103.72, and 10-year KTB futures fell 30 ticks to 109.07. Foreign investors net purchased 4,726 contracts of three-year KTB futures and 2,072 contracts of 10-year KTB futures. US nonfarm payrolls for October increased by 165,000, more than doubling market expectations of 65,000.

items.title: KTB 3-Year Auction Results in 1.1 Trillion Won Awarded at 3.650%
items.summary: The Ministry of Finance and Economy held an auction for 1.1 trillion won of three-year Korea Treasury bonds on November 9 from 10:40 AM to 11:00 AM. Total bids reached 3.333 trillion won, resulting in a bid-to-cover ratio of 303.0%. Bidding rates ranged from 3.620% to 3.685%. The entire 1.1 trillion won was awarded at a weighted average auction rate and lowest/highest accepted rate of 3.650%. The partial allocation rate for the auction was recorded at 50.2%.
items.summary_ko: 재정경제부는 9일 오전 10시 40분부터 11시까지 3년물 국고채 1,100억 원 규모의 입찰을 실시했다. 응찰 금액은 3조3,330억 원을 기록해 응찰률 303.0%를 나타냈다. 응찰 금리는 3.620%에서 3.685% 사이에 분포했다. 낙찰 금액은 1조1,000억 원 전액 배정되었으며 최저, 최고, 가중평균 낙찰금리는 모두 3.650%를 기록했다. 부분낙찰률은 50.2%로 집계됐다.

items.title: KTB 3-Year Advance Issuance Allocates 1.1 Trillion Won at 3.645%
items.summary: The Ministry of Finance and Economy conducted an advance issuance auction for three-year KTBs on November 9 from 9:40 AM to 10:00 AM for an amount of 1.1 trillion won. Bids totaled 3.534 trillion won, producing a bid-to-cover ratio of 321.3%. Participating bids were submitted within a rate range of 3.615% to 3.695%. The full 1.1 trillion won was awarded at a weighted average rate and lowest/highest accepted rate of 3.645%. The partial allocation rate for the advance issuance tender stood at 22.5%.

items.title: Foreign KTB Futures Net Positions Near Long-Term Averages
items.title_ko: 외국인 국고채 선물 누적 순매수 포지션 장기 평균 근접
items.summary: Foreign investors' cumulative net purchase position in three-year KTB futures recently approached 200,000 contracts. Market participants generally view the long-term average for foreign net purchases in three-year KTB futures between 200,000 and 250,000 contracts. Foreign investors shifted to accumulating net long positions following Bank of Korea rate hikes in July and August. Cumulative net purchase positions for 10-year KTB futures also neared 100,000 contracts, reaching historical averages. Market analysts expressed mixed views on whether foreign investors will expand net long positions further given the ongoing rate-hike cycle.
items.summary_ko: 외국인의 3년 국채선물 누적 순매수 포지션이 최근 20만 계약에 가까워진 것으로 나타났다. 시장은 통상 3년 국채선물 외국인 누적 순매수 포지션의 장기 평균을 20만~25만 계약 수준으로 보고 있다. 외국인은 한국은행이 7월과 8월 연속 인상을 단행한 이후 순매수 포지션을 점차 쌓아왔다. 10년 국채선물 누적 순매수 포지션 역시 10만 계약에 근접하며 장기 평균에 도달했다. 금리 인상기가 지속되는 가운데 외국인의 추가 매수 여력과 지속성에 대해서는 시장 참여자들의 시각이 엇갈리고 있다.

items.title: Foreign Investors Net Sell 1.06 Trillion Won in Won Bonds Last Week
items.title_ko: 외국인 지난주 원화채권 1조 원대 순매도 기록
items.summary: Foreign investors net sold 1,067.2 billion won of Korean won-denominated bonds during the week of November 2 to November 6. On the final trading day of last week, foreign participants offloaded 334.6 billion won of won bonds in the OTC market. On November 6, foreign investors purchased 45.4 billion won of public-sector bonds and 50 billion won of Monetary Stabilization Bonds, while net selling 429.9 billion won of government bonds. For the entire week, foreign investors net sold 1,023.2 billion won of government bonds and 150 billion won of Monetary Stabilization Bonds. Major individual transactions included net purchases of 397.4 billion won in KTBs maturing in September 2056 and net sales of 499.7 billion won in KTBs maturing in September 2054.
items.summary_ko: 외국인은 11월 2일부터 6일까지 한 주 동안 1조 672억 원 규모의 원화채권을 순매도했다. 지난주 마지막 거래일 장외시장에서 외국인은 원화채 3,346억 원을 팔았다. 외국인은 6일 공사ㆍ공단채 454억 원과 통안채 500억 원을 매수하고 국채 4,299억 원을 순매도했다. 지난 한 주간 전체로는 국채 1조 232억 원과 통안채 1,500억 원을 순매도한 것으로 집계됐다. 종목별 주간 거래에서는 2056년 9월 만기 국고채가 3,974억 원 순매수된 반면 2054년 9월 만기 국고채는 4,997억 원 순매도됐다.
